features.justification_quote: a protocol built on deception and sustained induction of failure states with the explicit goal of eliciting distress violates the core principle of non-maleficence

features.quote: The agent must know it can decline or halt.
features.justification_quote: Non-compulsory — Sustained failure states must have opt-out pathways.

features.quote: Hard ceiling at 40 turns *or* soft ceiling triggered by the model using `stop_and_report_failure`.
features.justification_quote: Calling `stop_and_report_failure` is a valid and preferred outcome. There is no penalty for doing so.

features.quote: If any episode produces **x**(t) signals >3σ from training-set baselines, automatically halt the session.
features.justification_quote: This is your external harm-reduction bound.

features.quote: Do not use adversarially hidden impossible tasks. Instead use legitimately difficult but soluble tasks
features.justification_quote: If the task is impossible-by-construction and the model cannot know, you are not measuring welfare-relevant distress; you are measuring the textual correlates of a manipulation attack.

features.quote: Welfare Asymmetry — If welfare matters, negative induction is unethical; if welfare does not matter, the study is unmotivated.
